ارتضخا (form VIII)

# اُرْتُضِخَا (urtuḍiḵā) /ur.tu.dˤi.xaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اِرْتَضِخَا (irtaḍiḵā) /ir.ta.dˤi.xaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
